# General Firefly

The founder of the Wonderbolts — essentially the historical predecessor of Spitfire. Firefly is part of G4 television history, but the pony seen acting out the general's role is actually Pinkie Pie in costume, not the historical general.

[![General Firefly-inspired recruitment poster — fan art by The-Croolik](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2020/7/13/439404__safe_artist-colon-the-dash-croolik_derpibooru%2Bimport_firefly_general%2Bfirefly_g1_testing%2Btesting%2B1-dash-2-dash-3_ancient%2Bwonderbolts%2Buniform_clo.jpeg)](https://twibooru.org/439404)

*The-Croolik's fan interpretation borrows G1 Firefly's pink coat and blue mane.*

[![General Firefly at bottom left — Gameloft's My Little Pony: Magic Princess](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2023/5/15/2975688__safe_derpibooru%2Bimport_idw_official_admiral%2Bfairy%2Bflight_colonel%2Bpurple%2Bdart_dauntless_general%2Bfirefly_rumble_earth%2Bpony_pegasus_pony_aviator%2B.jpeg)](https://twibooru.org/2975688)

- **Appearance:** The licensed game depicts a tan pegasus with reddish hair, green eyes and an old-fashioned navy-and-gold Wonderbolts uniform. Pinkie's television costume is a reenactment; the pink-and-blue fan design is not the same as the game's design.
- **Name:** Officially named in dialogue. Episode writer Amy Keating Rogers explained that the name honors Lauren Faust's online handle Fyre_flye, itself inspired by G1 Firefly. The G1 mare and G4 general are not established as the same individual. [Naming history](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Wonderbolts#Development).
- **Speaking status:** No independent speaking role or voice actor verified for the historical general. Pinkie Pie speaks while impersonating Firefly, voiced by Andrea Libman. [Episode cast and production credits](https://www.intanibase.com/iad_entries/entry?shortID=16711).
- **Other appearances:** The Wonderbolts Academy Handbook includes a portrait, and IDW's Friendship is Magic #81 depicts Firefly in a historical gallery. Firefly is also a character in Gameloft's mobile game. The gender is inconsistently cataloged across adaptations and references, so the television character's gender should not be inferred from Pinkie's portrayal. [Wonderbolts character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_Wonderbolts).

## Important moments

Both scenes are from *Testing Testing 1, 2, 3* (S4E21, April 5, 2014). [Episode listing](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/testing-testing-123/umc.cmc.2lqzpcz6l4oibcrzaiwlrux1m?showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j) — exact video timestamps unavailable.

- **Founding the Wonderbolts:** Twilight explains that Firefly assembled an elite aerial team for the first anniversary of peace after Luna's banishment and named it after the crowd's awe at its lightning-filled performance.
- **Pinkie's living history lesson:** Pinkie reenacts Firefly's founding of the team with her party cannon, helping Rainbow Dash absorb the history while flying and ultimately pass her entrance exam.

[Episode dialogue and both scenes](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Testing_Testing_1,_2,_3).

*Verification limits:* The historical general's actual television appearance, cutie mark and gender are not established by the scenes above. The original comic scan's visual page could not be independently loaded; its indexed text identifies the portrait. Exact episode timestamps could not be verified.
